detailZh: 奥利弗·贝尔曼：哈斯车队老板科马苏愤怒否认了关于英国车手要求500万英镑年薪的报道。

哈斯车队负责人科马苏否认了关于奥利弗·贝尔曼即将离开车队的猜测。
哈斯车队老板科马苏愤怒否认了关于合同延期谈判因奥利弗·贝尔曼要求500万英镑年薪而受阻的报道。
贝尔曼和Komatsu在最近几周表示，他们相信将会达成一项协议，延长这位21岁车手的当前合同，该合同将在2026赛季结束时到期。
随着哈斯车队已经宣布签下贝尔曼的法拉利青训车队队友Rafael Camara，以取代奥康下赛季的位置，他未来计划的未确认状态引发了关于阻碍交易的问题的猜测。

在墨西哥城大奖赛周五被问及贝尔曼的财务要求是主要争议点时，Komatsu表示：“我不知道这从何而来。”
本赛季我也经历过这种情况。人们说无风不起浪，但事实上有些人会编造故事。
在迈阿密发生了什么？据称，我和(贝尔曼的队友)奥康发生了争执。这完全没有事实依据，甚至那些声称他们有内部信息的人，完全是胡说八道。
“这次我又不知道是谁提出了这个六百万欧元的数字。第一次我在Instagram上看到它，或者说是Stu [Morrison, 哈斯公关官]转发给我的，我当时就想着，'哦，又一个很好的……有人出来搅局了'。
天空体育的克雷格·斯莱特会见拉斐尔·卡马拉，埃斯蒂班·奥康的哈斯车队2027年的替代者
这些人显然不是想帮助任何事情，对吧？现在的人们不检查来源真是太令人惊讶了。
所以，好吧，我想吸引更多的点击量，我想吸引更多的点赞，所以他们复制粘贴那些故事，继续传播，然后你还没反应过来，就像有20个人在传播他们认为的事实。这完全是胡说八道。”
虽然小松拒绝透露阻止达成协议的细节，但他坚持说车队"希望与贝尔曼一起成长"。
"我不喜欢深入讨论我们的合同细节，"小松说。"奥利展现出了惊人的潜力。他做出了很多贡献，并且正在为车队成功做出更多贡献。
小松否认哈斯是法拉利的B车队，因为法拉利青训车手卡马拉与贝尔曼签约后，
"我们希望一起成长，我们希望作为团队提升排名，所以首先我们需要一辆有竞争力的赛车。"
"2027年不会是容易的挑战，因为2026年我们犯了一个错误，所以这也将导致2027年也要付出代价。"
我们的重点是真正地最大化所有可控的因素，所以真正地努力推出一款具有竞争力的2027年赛车，然后希望Ollie也能加入驾驶，然后我们再继续前进。
贝尔曼因为通过青训车队加入了法拉利，所以仍然与法拉利保持着联系，并且没有隐瞒他想要在意大利车队获得一个位置的愿望。
然而，他坚持认为，尽管在法拉利——或者F1的其他顶级车队——获得一个位置仍然遥不可及，但他渴望继续在哈斯车队进行他的F1之旅。
在墨西哥的周四，贝尔曼表示：“我认为这非常清楚。我想继续与哈斯合作。这绝对是我的目标。”
在驾驶了艾尔顿·塞纳1985年的Lotus 97T赛车后，贝尔曼情绪激动，这辆赛车是塞纳赢得他首个一级方程式胜利的赛车
“有一些背景工作我们在进行中，但非常明确的是，继续与哈斯合作将是我目标，我们正在这方面最终确定一些事情。”
当被问及延迟的原因时，贝尔曼坚持表示，如果由他决定，到这个时候交易就已经完成了。
“这真的不在我手中，我可以告诉你，”他补充道。
“如果由我来决定，这早就已经宣布了。”
“但我们正在处理一些更大的问题。”

detailEn: Oliver Bearman: Haas boss Ayao Komatsu furiously dismisses reports claiming British driver is demanding £5m annual salary
Watch every Mexico City GP session live on Sky Sports F1, with qualifying at 9pm on Saturday and the race at 8pm on Sunday
Haas team principal Ayao Komatsu has dismissed speculation suggesting Oliver Bearman will be leaving the team
Haas boss Ayao Komatsu has furiously dismissed reports claiming that contract extension talks with Oliver Bearman are being held up by the British driver demanding a £5m annual salary.
Both Bearman and Komatsu have expressed confidence in recent weeks that a deal will be done to extend the 21-year-old's current contract, which expires at the end of the 2026 season.

With Haas having already announced the signing of Bearman's fellow Ferrari junior Rafael Camara to replace Esteban Ocon next season, the lack of confirmation on his own future has led to speculation over what the issues are that are holding up the deal.

Asked on Friday at the Mexico City Grand Prix about claims that Bearman's financial demands are the main sticking point, Komatsu said: "I have no idea where that comes from.
"I've experienced this sometimes this season as well. People say there's no smoke without fire but really some people will invent a story.

"What happened in Miami? Apparently, I had an argument with (Bearman's team-mate) Esteban Ocon. There's just absolutely zero truth in it and even those people claiming that they had some insider information etc, absolute total nonsense.

"This one again I don't know who smoked up this six-million euros number. The first time I saw it on Instagram, or Stu [Morrison, Haas press officer] forwarded it to me, and I was just like, 'oh another great… somebody has come up and stirred up whatever'.
Sky Sports' Craig Slater meets Rafael Camara, Esteban Ocon's Haas replacement for 2027
"Those people clearly are not trying to help anything right? It's amazing these days that people don't check the source.

"So, ok I want to get some more clicks, I want to get some more likes, so they copy and paste those stories and keep running with it, then before you know it, like 20 people are running the stories that they think it's a truth. It's absolute nonsense."
While Komatsu refused to reveal the details that are preventing an agreement from being reached, he insisted the team "want to grow together" with Bearman.
"I don't like to go into the details of our contract," Komatsu said. "Ollie is showing amazing potential. He contributed a lot and he's contributing a lot to the team's success.
Komatsu denies Haas are a Ferrari B team after Ferrari junior driver Camara signs alongside Bearman
"We want to grow together, we want to move up the grid as a team, so first and foremost we need a competitive car.
"2027 is not going to be the easy challenge because 2026 we made a mistake, so that's paying the price for 2027 as well.
"Our focus is really to maximise everything under control, so really trying to roll out a competitive 2027 car and then hopefully we'll have Ollie driving as well and then take it from there."
Bearman remains attached to Ferrari having come through the team's junior programme, and has made no secret of his desire to earn a seat with the Italian squad.
However, he insists that while a seat at Ferrari - or one of F1's other established top teams - remains out of reach, he is keen to continue his F1 journey with Haas.
Speaking on Thursday in Mexico, Bearman said. "I think it's very clear. I want to continue with Haas. That's definitely my goal.
Bearman was reduced to tears after driving Ayrton Senna's 1985 Lotus 97T, the car Senna drove to his first-ever Formula 1 victory
"There are a few things in the background that we're working on, but it's been very clear that continuing with Haas will be my target, and we're just finalising a few things on that front."
Asked about the delay, Bearman insisted that a deal would have been finalised by this point if it was up to him.
"It's not really in my hands, I can tell you that," he added.
"If it was up to me, it would have already been announced a long time ago.
"But there are a few bigger-picture things that we're working on."

周六最后一节练习赛前又发生了更多戏剧性事件，哈斯车队做出令人震惊的决定，用替补车手平川亮替换埃斯特班·奥康，参加本周末剩余的比赛。

detailEn: Mexico City GP: Lando Norris pips Kimi Antonelli in final practice to set up thrilling Mexico qualifying

Lando Norris and Kimi Antonelli were separated by just 0.001s at the top of the timesheet in final practice for the Mexico City Grand Prix; watch qualifying later at 9pm with Sunday's race at 8pm (build-up from 6.30pm), live on Sky Sports F1

Sky Sports F1's David Croft and Karun Chandok discuss Esteban Ocon being replaced by Haas for the Mexico City GP, Liam Lawson and Max Verstappen being handed a grid penalty for their P2 collision and Isack Hajar's paddock altercation with a fan
McLaren's Lando Norris pipped Mercedes' Kimi Antonelli by 0.001s in final practice for the Mexico City Grand Prix to set up a thrilling qualifying.
Ferrari's Charles Leclerc had topped both of Friday's practice sessions but McLaren and Mercedes showed their hand to outpace the Monegasque driver by one tenth of a second.
Antonelli is likely to become world champion in Sunday's race as he only needs a top-nine finish to secure the Formula 1 drivers' title.

McLaren's Oscar Piastri was fourth while Red Bull appear to be out of the pole position battle as Max Verstappen was 0.351s off the pace, but there seems to be a genuine three-team fight at the front for qualifying later on Saturday at 9pm (build-up from 8pm), live on Sky Sports F1.
Regardless of what he does in qualifying, Verstappen cannot start on pole position as he and Racing Bulls' Liam Lawson have a one-grid place penalty for colliding in second practice on Friday.
The stewards called the incident "unacceptable", with both drivers admitting the clash was "unnecessary and clumsy".
Racing Bulls' Liam Lawson and Red Bull's Max Verstappen make contact during FP2 at the Mexico City GP - the clash would eventually lead to both drivers receiving a grid penalty
More drama took place before final practice on Saturday as Haas made the shock decision to replace Esteban Ocon with reserve driver Ryo Hirakawa for the remainder of the weekend.
The team provided no reason for replacing Ocon, but confirmed the Frenchman was not suffering from illness.
Haas recently confirmed that Ocon will be leaving the team at the end of this season after two years with the American-owned squad, with Brazilian youngster Rafael Camara signed as his replacement.
Hirakwa, a 24 Hours of Le Mans winner, has taken part in several practice sessions for Haas over the last two years and was 19th in final practice, six tenths down on team-mate Oliver Bearman.

埃斯特班·奥康已在哈斯被平川亮接替，参加墨西哥城大奖赛剩余赛程。
车队未说明换下奥康的原因，但确认这位法国车手并非患病。
奥康在第二次练习赛后以第13名完赛，在车队无线电中发泄了自己的不满，并且将不再参加本站比赛的任何环节，因为平川亮将在罗德里格斯兄弟赛道顶替他的发车位。
奥康质疑了车队在周五第二次练习赛中让他使用中性胎而非软胎的决定。
这位法国车手在被赛事工程师劳拉·穆勒告知其驾驶计划有变后，恳求道“别这样对我”。
哈斯车队最近确认，奥康将在本赛季结束后离开这支美国所有的车队，他已在队效力两年。
车队声明写道：“TGR哈斯F1车队储备车手平川亮将在本周末墨西哥城大奖赛的剩余赛程中替换埃斯特班·奥康，时间为10月31日星期六至11月1日星期日。”
“平川亮（32岁）曾随丰田GAZOO Racing两度赢得国际汽联世界耐力锦标赛冠军（2022年、2023年），并夺得勒芒24小时耐力赛冠军（2022年）。他于10月30日星期五在罗德里格斯兄弟赛道参加了第一节自由练习，这是他本赛季第三次驾驶VF-26赛车出战自由练习，最终位列全场第15名。”
“这位日本车手将在星期六的第三节自由练习和排位赛以及星期日的71圈大奖赛中与队友奥利·贝尔曼搭档——这将是平川亮的F1正赛首秀。”

detailEn: Esteban Ocon: Haas replace French driver with Ryo Hirakawa for remainder of Mexico City GP weekend without providing reason

Esteban Ocon will take no further part in the Mexico City GP, with Haas replacing French driver with Ryo Hirakawa; Haas gave no reason for Ocon's replacement; Ocon is leaving the team at the end of the season
Esteban Ocon has been replaced by Ryo Hirakawa at Haas for the remainder of the Mexico City Grand Prix.
The team provided no reason for replacing Ocon, but confirmed the Frenchman was not suffering from illness.

Ocon vented his frustrations on the team radio while finishing 13th following second practice and will take no further part in the race as Hirakawa will take his place on the grid at the Autodromo Hermanos Rodríguez.
Ocon questioned the team's decision to run him on the medium rather than soft tyre during second practice on Friday.
The Frenchman pleaded "don't do this to me" to his race engineer Laura Mueller after being informed of a change to his run-plan.
Haas recently confirmed that Ocon will be leaving the team at the end of this season after two years with the American-owned squad.
A team statement read: "TGR Haas F1 Team reserve driver Ryō Hirakawa will replace Esteban Ocon for the remainder of the weekend's Mexico City Grand Prix, Saturday 31 October - Sunday 1 November.

"Hirakawa (32), a two-time winner of the FIA World Endurance Championship (2022, 2023) and 24 Hours of Le Mans Winner (2022) with Toyota GAZOO Racing, participated in FP1 at the Autodromo Hermanos Rodriguez on Friday 30 October - his third free practice outing of the season driving the VF-26, finishing 15th overall.
"The Japanese driver will partner teammate Ollie Bearman through final practice and qualifying on Saturday and Sunday's 71-lap grand prix - Hirakawa's Formula 1 race debut."
